question: Will Solana dip to $10 in May?
reasoning: This market resolves YES if any Binance 1-minute SOL/USDT candle hits a low of $10 or below in May 2026. A dip to $10 would be an ~80-90% crash from current levels in 11 days — virtually impossible without a catastrophic black-swan event. Even in the 2022 crypto winter (FTX collapse, 3AC bankruptcy, Terra/Luna meltdown), SOL bottomed at ~$8 with massive selling pressure. Current market conditions are far from that level of panic. The 0.1% YES price is appropriate — efficient price should be ~0.01%. This is effectively a free-money NO prediction.
